content.short: Crypto exchange with 10 million users offering spot, futures, copy trading, bots and TradFi.
content.description: Phemex lists around 170 spot coins, USDT and coin-margined perpetuals, copy trading, trading bots and a mock trading mode for beginners. It has added tokenized stocks and metals, on-chain derivatives, and prediction markets powered by Polymarket. Users can deposit fiat by SWIFT, SEPA or FPS without fees, buy with cards, and spend through the Phemex Card with cashback.
